library: aspire_style Push-T skill library (code-as-policy). Each skill: failure signature seen in a real trace, when to apply, repair strategy, code sketch, evidence.

base_program.name: S0 wrench-alignment contact choice
base_program.strategy: Score every reachable contact (point p, push direction n) on the T faces by the cosine between its unit wrench (n, (p-c) x n / rho) and the desired twist (goal_xy - xy, rho * wrap(goal_th - th)); walk around the block to the pre-contact point; push along n by a depth proportional to the remaining error.
base_program.code_sketch: w = [n_w, cross(p - com, n)/rho]; s = w.dot([ep, rho*eth]) / |w||tw|; best = argmax(s - lam*travel/100); tgt = touch + n_w*clip(k*|tw|*s, dmin, dmax)

skills.name: travel-cost and contact persistence
skills.failure_signature: Trace segmentation shows >80% of steps in approach; contacts alternate A/B with ~28-step walks per ~7-step push; a push ends while its contact still has alignment > 0.8 because another contact is 0.15 better.
skills.when_to_apply: Whenever the fraction of free (non-contact) steps exceeds ~0.6 or pushes are much shorter than walks.
skills.repair: Subtract lam * (orbit arc + radial distance to the pre-contact point)/100 from each contact's score; keep the current contact until its alignment drops below 0.45 or another beats it by 0.35.
skills.code_sketch: travel = R_orb*|wrap(ang(pre-c) - ang(q-c))| + ||q-c| - |pre-c||; sc = s - lam*travel/100; switch if s[cur] < keep or sc[best] > sc[cur] + hyst

skills.name: lagging position-controlled pusher
skills.failure_signature: Pusher covers ~40% of the distance to its target per step; slow walks.
skills.repair: Fitted response dq = 0.30 (target - q) + 0.30 v dt (lives 1-2, both axes); command targets 90 u ahead, orbit the block on a 112 u circle with an 80 u look-ahead, corridor approach in 15 u increments.
skills.code_sketch: tgt = q + d/|d| * min(|d|, 90); orbit: phi += sign(dphi)*min(|dphi|, 80/R_orb)

skills.name: centre of mass is not where the drawing suggests
skills.failure_signature: Rotation per unit push does not match the nominal-area centroid (0, 40.7).
skills.when_to_apply: Every torque / lever-arm computation in the contact score.
skills.repair: Linear regression dth = k*((p - c) x n)*L over contact steps; pooled over 4 lives c = (2.6, 43.5), bootstrap sd (1.4, 1.6); program uses (3, 44). Per-life estimates scatter from -5 to +7 in u, so only the v-shift (~+3 u toward the stem) and a small +u shift are supported.
skills.code_sketch: X = [cross(p,n)*L, -n_v*L, n_u*L]; coef = lstsq(X, dth); com = (coef1/coef0, coef2/coef0)

skills.name: corner slip / sliding contact
skills.failure_signature: Repeated 'push 3-5 steps -> lateral drift > tolerance -> 7-step re-approach' on the same contact near a corner (life 2 t=13-46, life 3 t=14-62), coverage not improving.
skills.when_to_apply: Contacts within ~7 u of a corner; any push whose pusher drifts along the face as the block turns.
skills.repair: Trim candidate faces away from corners (v3); while pushing, re-anchor the contact to the pusher's actual position along the same face instead of abandoning the push (v4).
skills.code_sketch: same = F == F[cur]; j = argmin |qb - (P[same] - N[same]*r)|; if min < lat_tol+4: cur = j

skills.name: coasting block
skills.failure_signature: Block keeps moving after contact ends; motion decays by ~0.63 per step (total ~1.7x the last step); near the goal a push overshoots (life 3 t=222: 0.943 -> 0.916).
skills.when_to_apply: Pushes when the twist error is < 25.
skills.repair: Stop the push (back the pusher off 4 u) when the remaining error along the contact's wrench <= 1.7 x the block's last-step motion along it + 0.5.
skills.code_sketch: mv = w.dot([dxy, rho*dth]); if rem <= 1.7*max(mv,0) + 0.5: depth = -4

skills.name: precision phase dominated by walking
skills.failure_signature: Going from coverage 0.8 to 0.95 took 83-111 steps (lives 3-4), ~2/3 of them walking between contacts.
skills.repair: Raise the travel weight (0.25 -> 0.6) and lower the keep threshold (0.45 -> 0.3) so corrections use nearby faces.
skills.code_sketch: prec = nt < 20; sc = s - (0.6 if prec else 0.25)*travel/100; keep = 0.3 if prec else 0.45

skills.name: tempo: the program runs out of time
skills.failure_signature: Official evaluation of v5: 10/50 success, median 300 steps, median max coverage 0.86; official lives all ended just above 0.95 after 105-278 steps with the block motionless during long walks.
skills.when_to_apply: Any free-space motion and coarse pushes.
skills.repair: Amplify free-space commands x2 (pusher closes only ~40% of the gap per step), orbit look-ahead 110 u on a circle 10 u outside the orbit, corridor tolerance 6 u with 1.5x steps, coarse push depth k=0.5 up to 40 u.
skills.code_sketch: tgt = q + d/|d| * min(2|d|, 120); corridor: q + (pre-q)/|pre-q| * min(1.5|pre-q|, 25)

skills.name: travel-cost deadlock
skills.failure_signature: Stuck for 272 steps in 'push' on a contact with alignment ~0.01, pusher parked 4 u behind it (coast stop), block motionless (x1 life 2, coverage 0.82). Cause: travel cost of every well-aligned contact exceeded its alignment, so the program kept picking the adjacent point on the same face.
skills.when_to_apply: Contact selection whenever a travel cost is in the score.
skills.repair: Contacts below the keep threshold are never selected (unless none qualifies); stall watchdog bans the current contact for 25 steps after 6 motionless 'push' steps.
skills.code_sketch: sc = where(s >= keep, sc, -inf) if any(s >= keep); if still >= 6: ban[cur] = t + 25

skills.name: low-alignment pushes undo progress
skills.failure_signature: Coverage drops during pushes started on contacts with alignment 0.33-0.55 (x1 life 5: 0.937 -> 0.85, 0.78 -> 0.59).
skills.repair: A new contact needs alignment >= 0.6 (fallback: keep threshold, then best available); an ongoing push may continue down to the keep threshold.
skills.code_sketch: sc = where(s >= 0.6, sc, -inf) if any(s >= 0.6); sc[cur] = cur_sc if cur still >= keep

skills.name: shape transfer
skills.failure_signature: New object; the program had the T's polygon and faces built in.
skills.repair: Read the shape from task_card in bind(); build the polygon and reachable faces from it with the T's clearance rules (>= ~8 u from convex corners, >= r+3 from an adjoining concave wall); start the COM at the area centroid. Verified offline: contact pusher centres keep 15.00 u clearance; v9 reproduces v8 exactly on logged T lives.
skills.code_sketch: SHAPES = {'T': {...}, 'L': {rects: (LEG, FOOT), faces: [...], com: ...}}; bind: set_shape(card['object'])

skills.name: the L turns much less per push than the T
skills.failure_signature: Angle error falls slowly in a fixed 4-contact cycle (L life 1: +69 -> +2.5 deg in 300 steps) although position error is small.
skills.when_to_apply: Contact scoring on an object whose rotation/translation response differs from the T's.
skills.repair: Measure rotation and translation per unit of push (same regression tool as S3): L 0.81 u and 0.000068 rad per u*u of lever vs T 0.56 u and 0.00014 -> relative turning ~1/1.9..1/2.9. Predicted motion direction of a contact = [n, tau/(g rho)], g = 2.5 for the L.

skills.name: relative alignment thresholds
skills.failure_signature: Best achievable alignment on the L is 0.55-0.65, so absolute T thresholds (keep 0.45 / select 0.6) end pushes at once.
skills.repair: keep = max(0.2, min(abs, 0.75 x best)), select = max(0.2, min(0.6, 0.9 x best)); unchanged on the T when best >= 0.67.
skills.code_sketch: kth = max(0.2, min(keep, 0.75*smax)); sel = max(0.2, min(select_min, 0.9*smax))
validated_on: v10 reproduces v8 on logged T lives

skills.name: twist about the centre of mass
skills.failure_signature: Large angle error while the body ORIGIN is near its goal (L life 2: eth +83 deg, origin 2 u off, COM ~80 u off); pushes judged as if translation were done; coverage <= 0.43.
skills.when_to_apply: Any block whose body origin is far from its COM (the L's origin is its outer corner, ~61 u from the COM).
skills.repair: Translation error and coast estimate use the COM point (goal COM = goal_xy + R(goal_th) com); while |eth| > 15 deg weight the translation part of the desired twist 0.5.
skills.code_sketch: ep = goal_xy + R(goal_th) @ com - (xy + R(th) @ com); tw = [wt*ep, rho*eth]

skills.name: push depth in push units
skills.failure_signature: Later pushes turned the L only 1-4 deg in 6 steps (depth ~8 u, pusher ~2.4 u/step).
skills.when_to_apply: Outside the precision phase on objects with g > 1.
skills.repair: Depth = 0.5 x |[ep, rho g eth]| x alignment (rotation part scaled by g).
skills.code_sketch: remp = norm([ep, rho*g*eth]) * s; depth = clip(0.5*remp, 2, 40)
validated_on: x1 life 2, seed 29: success at step 267 (0.78 -> 0.952)

skills.name: push commitment
skills.failure_signature: ~80% of steps walking; pushes of 2-4 steps each followed by 9-22-step walks (x2 life 1, seed 41, 0.862).
skills.when_to_apply: Objects that need long pushes to turn (commit = 6 on the L, 0 on the T).
skills.repair: Keep a started push for >= 6 push steps unless alignment < 0.1, banned, or (|eth| > 15 deg) its torque has the wrong sign.
skills.code_sketch: if mode=='push' and push_steps < commit and s[cur] > 0.1 and tau_cur*eth > 0: keep

skills.name: leaving the block fast
skills.failure_signature: Phase breakdown: 76/300 steps in the radial exit at 10.9 u/step (x2 life 2).
skills.when_to_apply: Free-space navigation when the pusher is inside the orbit circle.
skills.repair: Radial exit commands twice the remaining radial distance and starts advancing along the orbit beyond 0.85 R_orb; corridor approach commands 2x the gap.
skills.code_sketch: r_cmd = dq + 2*(R_orb - dq); if dq > 0.85*R_orb: phq += sign(dph)*min(|dph|, 0.5*look/R_orb)

skills.name: precision-phase depth
skills.failure_signature: Near the goal coverage rose during walks and fell during each push (0.940 -> 0.923).
skills.repair: Use the T-validated depth (coverage units) inside the precision phase; push-unit depth (S10b) only outside it.
skills.code_sketch: depth = clip(0.5*(rem if prec else remp), 2, 40)
validated_on: x3 life 2 (seed 53, failure 0.890; started at eth +151 deg, barely reached the precision phase)

skills.name: approach-stall watchdog (code world)
skills.failure_signature: Imagined 0-coverage episodes near walls: pusher pinned at the clipped wall line for 300 steps while orbiting toward an orbit point outside the walls.
skills.repair: If the pusher moved < 1 u for 5 approach steps, ban that contact for 25 steps. (Orbit-direction choice and launch-point feasibility were tried; orbit choice hurt, launch neutral.)
skills.code_sketch: if mode=='approach' and |q-prev_q|<1: still_q+=1; if still_q>=5: ban[cur]=t+25

final_program: policy_v8.py (extended); policy_v5.py was the official program

changed: S3 (COM re-estimated on the L; pooled fit (37.4, 48.8) vs centroid (37.6, 42.6))

final_program_L: policy_v15.py (extended); policy_v10.py was the official L program
